name: Are you ready?
source:
"If chance continues twice, it is inevitable"
A love story that continues from the past to the present and the future.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2221]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“偶然若接连发生两次，便是必然。”
一个从过去延续到现在，再通向未来的爱情故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2221]NovelGame[/url]]
